weapons.name: Ion Pistol
weapons.projectile_description: Draw a small focused pale-blue ion dart with a cyan core, a short violet wake, and one restrained trailing spark.
weapons.muzzle_description: Draw a compact pale-blue electrical lance with a narrow cyan center and restrained violet side sparks.
weapons.impact_description: Draw a small pale-blue electrical snap with a thin cyan ring and several short violet radial sparks.

weapons.name: Plasma Carbine
weapons.projectile_description: Draw a medium elongated cyan plasma bolt with a white-hot center, a controlled violet tail, and two short trailing sparks.
weapons.muzzle_description: Draw a medium cyan-white tapered plasma cone with a few restrained violet branches.
weapons.impact_description: Draw a medium cyan plasma burst with a white center, violet energy ring, and short radial sparks.

weapons.name: Pulse Rifle
weapons.projectile_description: Draw a narrow rhythmic cyan-white pulse bolt with two bright separated core bands and a restrained violet wake.
weapons.muzzle_description: Draw a clean cyan-white pulse wedge with two visible horizontal energy bands and minimal violet sparks.
weapons.impact_description: Draw a crisp concentric cyan-white pulse impact with two thin rings and restrained violet sparks.

weapons.name: Energy Shotgun
weapons.projectile_description: Draw a tight horizontal cluster of five small cyan-white energy pellets spreading only slightly toward the right, with restrained violet traces.
weapons.muzzle_description: Draw a broad but short cyan-white muzzle fan with several distinct energy prongs and restrained violet sparks.
weapons.impact_description: Draw a clustered cyan-white multi-pellet impact with several small overlapping bursts and restrained violet arcs.

weapons.name: Rail Rifle
weapons.projectile_description: Draw a very narrow high-speed white-blue rail slug with a long straight cyan wake and minimal violet electrical filaments.
weapons.muzzle_description: Draw a long narrow white-blue rail lance with a straight cyan centerline and sparse violet electrical branches.
weapons.impact_description: Draw a sharp white-blue rail impact star with a compact cyan ring and a few long thin violet sparks.
